articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced that two abstracts detailing results from the Company’s ADDRESS-LC Phase 2 trial in Long COVID, and SUNRISE-PD Phase 2 trial of bezisterim in Parkinson’s Disease have been accepted for presentation at ANA2026 , the annual meeting of the American Neurological Association. Results of the two studies will be presented as posters during the conference. ANA2026 will be held in San Diego, CA from October 17-20, 2026. Long COVID — ADDRESS-LC Title: Results of a Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of the Efficacy and Safety of Bezisterim (NE3107) in Long COVID (ADDRESS-LC) Authors: Penelope Markham (BioVie), Michael J. Peluso (UCSF), Christopher Reading (BioVie), Clarence Ahlem (BioVie), Stephen O’Quinn (Perissos), Navid A. Samad (Samad
articles.title: BioVie to Present New Bezisterim Findings in Parkinson’s Disease and Long COVID at the 2026 American Neurological Association Annual Meeting
